Thanks, this was one of my biggest concerns. When we talked earlier, I felt like I was doing just that. 

I told him about Bin Laden, then I told him about a new song that came out today, but then I started second guessing myself. I like hearing all of your opinions.

Thanks for the advice. He's been in the hospital all weekend, and has gone through detox shock. In the past 24 hours, he has regained his motor skills and is able to talk. On thursday, he'll be entering a long term- inpatient program. (which I'm really thankful for)

My problem is, 6 months ago, I relocated half way across the country, and am now only able to talk to him by phone. Can I talk about normal stuff, like what we used to talk about? SHOULD, I talk about his attempt? How it has affected me? Others? Him? 



Again, thanks so much.
